defect: a toggling clock-mux select is constrained as a constant
rationale: sel_i controls which live clock reaches mux_clk and is an input that can change during operation. Case analysis fixes the mux to clk1_i and hides the other valid clock path.

mutation.description: Applied set_case_analysis 1 to the functional sel_i input.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the two-input clock mux expression and a register on the mux output; removed the assertion and implementation parameter.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Case analysis sel_i=1 selects clk1_i (12ns) yet mux_clk is defined at 10ns on the mux output, and clk0_i is silently disabled.
